mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the central bank's accommodative policy reduces discount rates and stimulates equity valuations.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% is less than 40% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals a severe labor market downturn that triggers a flight to quality and risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE > 9.5 is less than 60% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between low federal funds rates and high unemployment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 9.5%) indicates a deep recession with aggressive monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 and UNRATE > 9.5 is less than 40% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a recession, which typically triggers policy responses and market stabilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 60-day forward returns in periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 0 is less than 40% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI growth (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2.5 is less than 60% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low annualized CPI growth (CPIAUCSL <= 2.5%) is associated with stable inflation, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL annualized growth <= 2.5% is less than 40% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between declining housing starts (HOUST < 580,000) and falling industrial production (INDPRO < 90) signals a broad-based economic contraction, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: The proportion of positive 20-day forward returns in periods when HOUST < 580 and INDPRO < 90 is less than 40% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 (2017=100), it signals a significant contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors fear a deepening recession.
failure_condition: The proportion of negative 20-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO < 90 is less than 60% over a 3-year rolling window.
